profile.headline: Web developer
profile.summary: Focused information technology specialist who tackles tedious assignments while meeting deadlines. Possesses a self-motivated desire to share as well as gain knowledge in computer science field. Applies strong customer service and computer skills to digital projects and assigned tasks. Performs with a sense of urgency in time limited environments.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
*Screened and recruited technicians for election assignments throughout the state
of Georgia
*Created lines of communication from staffing agencies to the employees about
job requirements and expectations
*Verified completion of assignment for each employee
*Created badges and ensured employees had the proper credentials for work

positions.title: Web Administrator
positions.description:
• Branded the company through advertisements and graphics
• Created documentation and specification sheets for all lighting products
• Updated and maintained website through Shopify using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

positions.title: Benefit Adminstrator
positions.description:
• Provided telephonic enrollments for Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
• Troubleshoot disputes members have with the health platform
• Consulted members’ inquiries and concerns

positions.title: Benefits Administrator
positions.description:
-Provided telephonic enrollments for Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
-Troubleshoot issues member have with the health platform
-Answered member's inquiries about health coverage

positions.title: Technical Support Intern
positions.description:
-Assessed issues with software with Hawkes’ customers
-Assisted programmers with quality assurance through examining software and hardware
-Identified, troubleshoot and resolve an assortment of software, hardware and connectivity issues

positions.title: Helpdesk Assistant
positions.description:
-Modified resolved software, hardware and connectivity issues
-Corresponded routine reports communicating most frequent and least common problems
-Successfully provided technical support through high call volume seasons
-Documented helpdesk incident tickets and resolutions.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
*Developed and maintained a principle section of a proprietary geology program, U-Pb Redux, using XML and CSS.
*Created icons and banners using Photoshop.
*Executed different functions of the U-Pb Redux in order to properly document the help section.
*Utilized subversion (Cornerstone) to update help section version.
*Documented changes, updates, progress and feedback through a published blog.

company.name: College of Charleston Computer Science Department

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
*Part of the Information Technologies arm, assigned to decommission the NASA Goddard's current mailing list server
*Tested potential mail list administrator Sympa to determine most compatible site server
*Implemented mail list administrator, ListServ, over the course of 5 weeks
*Assisted NASA employees in forming a technical support group
*Responsible for aiding employees in installing the new software

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Launched a more recent mail list for upper level administration
• Implemented mail list administrator, ListServ
• Partnered with NASA staff in establishing and implementing a technical support group
